answer: Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a fable header. Replaying a stored transcript fails as the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a cedar spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Producing 57 answers an epoch therefore costs 26 real forward passes, and the pigment record lets any auditor recompute the check. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
